description.narrative: IFC is considering an investment of up to US$40 million or its KZT equivalent in a senior secured private placement bond (the IFC Investment) to be issued by Samal Finance LLC (Samal Finance), a subsidiary of KazFoodProduct LLC (KFP or the Group). The IFC investment will support Groups multi-year investment program , focused on expanding of the Group`s confectionary business and addressing increased working capital requirements.

The Project is expected to contribute to Kazakhstans economic development by supporting job creation, increasing value addition, and strengthening linkages across key sectors such as agriculture, logistics, and transportation. By sustaining and expanding the operations of a major local confectionery producer, it will help enhance domestic production capacity and support export activity, thereby contributing to foreign exchange generation. In addition, the Project will promote greater food availability and improve access to nutritious food products in both Kazakhstan and neighboring markets, including through the production of fortified goods. Furthermore, it will support inclusive employment, particularly for women, and advancing initiatives that promote gender equality in the workplace. Finally, the Project is expected to enhance competitiveness in the local food processing industry by sustaining a strong domestic player and supporting a more dynamic and competitive market environment.
